title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Quickly find the Tenant ID, Azure AD Instance, and Tenant Scope from the domain (tenant) name without signing in
summary: This post explains how to find a Business Central tenant's ID, Azure AD instance, and tenant scope using Microsoft's Where's My Tenant web tool, which requires only the domain name and no sign-in credentials.
key_points: The Where's My Tenant tool allows querying Azure AD for tenant information without password authentication
You can find the tenant GUID, verify if a tenant exists in Azure AD, and identify which Azure AD instance it resides in
The tool works with various domain formats including onmicrosoft.com domains, custom domains, and supports special regions like US Government and China
You can search either by tenant domain name or by entering the Tenant ID directly to find the Azure AD instance

quotes.text: this will show you if the tenant exists in Azure AD, what the tenant's GUID is, which Azure AD instance the tenant resides in
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core capabilities of the tool for discovering critical tenant information

quotes.text: Because this doesn't require a password, as long as you know the domain, you can view information such as Tenant ID.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the key advantage that the tool requires no authentication, making it accessible for quick lookups
